reading_findings.baseline: Explicit units/domains and choices; demand and supply correspondence solved globally. Surplus derivative proves allocation existence/uniqueness, then supporting prices separately verify decentralization. Zero-trade price interval prevents unconditional price uniqueness. Funding and demand derivatives are branch qualified, with a finite threshold-crossing example.
reading_findings.extension: Alternative technology and independent optimum added, total clearing re-solved. h>=c permits exhaustive active/inactive classification. Intermediate-value and monotonicity argument verifies active-branch conditions; all derivative identities and matched borrower accounting supplied. Infeasible negative alternative supply explicitly rejected.
reading_findings.rival: Separate monopoly extension uses nonnegative inverse-demand feasible interval, strict concavity and marginal revenue. Conduct comparison works across funding branches. Exact welfare decomposition keeps primitives fixed. A different-primitive monopoly matches baseline observed levels, showing lack of one-point identification without claiming full distributional equivalence.
reading_findings.instruction: Usable model memo, question-to-primitive process, conditions in propositions, observables/measurement bridge, conditional falsification and new-model re-solution taught through completed artifacts. Teach-back and delayed retention include answer guides.
reading_findings.sources: Two bounded retained primary inspections accurately reused and attributed. Current author claims no fresh primary-body read. No current facts, copied source problems, empirical fit or publication novelty asserted.
